notes.title: Patch v1.3 Windows, Linux, OSX - Now Available
notes.notes:
Thanks to community feedback on all versions of the game, the following have been implemented.

All Builds
Pause Menu
Fixed issue where text was missing for "Sensitivity(Mouse)"
Credits
Fixed location of credits, and the rate at which they scroll
Texture Quality
It was reported texture quality in the settings does not make much of a difference. It is a minor visual change, but it now affects quality of textures.
Screen Resolution Picker
Scrolling through the dropdown box was mentioned as being too slow, speed is now greater
Fixed issue of resolution defaulting to 640x480
Starting Location
Some users said the text accompanying the starting location did not match what was on screen, character has been relocated.


Linux
Flickering shadows 
Have switched from OpenGL to Vulkan rendering, which has elimated this issue in testing. This may come with a performance decrease. Fixes for the OpenGL renderer are still under review.


OSX
There have been no reported issues with OSX builds so far. 


Known Issues
Linux Only
Selecting objects - this is still a work in progress, but from testing is now at least a little better. More investigationg required.


Thank you to everyone who is playing and your continued support. If you encounter any issues please post them in the Technical Support discussion area.

notes.title: Update Notes - Patch v.1.2 - July 19th, 2021
notes.notes:
After further community feedback the following changes have been made:
[olist]
 Fix the hard cut for audio between end game scenes by introducing a delay
 Fix the house showing during transition to next scene
 In game options menu now allows user to change their mouse and controller sensitivity
 Warning sign on returning to title screen to show player data will not be saved
[/olist]

Known issues (not game-breaking):
[olist]
 Resolution picker in options menu doesn't reflect current resolution on load.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes - Patch 1.1 - July 18, 2021
notes.notes:
After some feedback the following changes have been made:
[olist]
 Updated Steam store page to better reflect estimated playtime.
 Added option for mouse Y inversion.
 Further testing and implementation of controller Y inversion.
 Smoothed transitions for ending scenes and returning to menu scene.
 Remove red box appearing in audio options.
 Fullscreen on/off bug in options menu resolved.
 Added credits after the ending scene of the game.
[/olist]

Thank you all for your support during launch!
